This Student Vocational Training Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into by and between INDIAN ALLIANCE SERVICES (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute") and Mr. Kiran Ishwar Kurhe (hereinafter referred to as the "Trainee").

RECITALS: Whereas the Institute is an independent academy providing vocational skill coaching, aviation communication grooming, and airport operational training modules; and whereas the Trainee has voluntarily applied for admission to enhance personal knowledge and career skills.

1. Training Program & Center Allocation

The Trainee is enrolled in the Aviation Ground Operations & Passenger Handling Skill Program. Training will be conducted at the Pune Regional Training Facility (Jagadguru Sant Tukaram Maharaj Pune International Airport Area / Lohegaon, Pune, Maharashtra - 411032). The scheduled batch orientation commences on 29-Nov-2026 for a structured duration of 3 months.

2. Verification of Credentials & Identity

Admission is subject to verification of the Trainee's educational testimonials, proof of age, address, and character certificates. If any document or statement provided is discovered to be fraudulent, misleading, or forged, the Institute reserves the right to immediately terminate the enrollment with forfeiture of fees, without prejudice to legal remedies.

3. Attendance & Academic Progression

Aviation operations require unwavering punctuality. The Trainee must maintain a minimum of 85% attendance across all theoretical classroom modules, customer service drills, and practical simulations. Unauthorized absence for continuous 5 days may result in batch de-registration.

4. Training Modules & Scope of Curriculum

The curriculum encompasses: (a) Aviation Industry Basics & Airport Terminal Layout; (b) Customer Relationship Management (CRM) & Passenger Assistance; (c) Check-in Procedures & Baggage Tagging Standards; (d) Passenger with Reduced Mobility (PRM) special handling; (e) Aviation Safety, Dangerous Goods Awareness & Emergency Drills; and (f) Executive Grooming & Interview Readiness.

5. Grooming, Uniform & Discipline Standards

The Trainee shall strictly maintain the professional grooming guidelines established by the Institute, including prescribed business attire, neat appearance, and respectful decorum. No unruly behavior, insubordination, or disturbance in the training facility will be tolerated.

6. Training Fees, Tuition & Facilities

The training fees charged are strictly tuition charges for instruction, coaching materials, and administrative facility overheads. Official GST-compliant receipts will be issued for all payments made through official bank channels. The Institute does NOT demand arbitrary security deposits, gate-pass clearance charges, or unauthorized cash collections.

7. STRICT STATUTORY DISCLAIMER - NO EMPLOYMENT OR PLACEMENT GUARANTEE: (A) NON-EMPLOYMENT STATUS: Indian Alliance Services is solely an independent vocational training and career advisory academy. This Agreement is EXCLUSIVELY for skills training and learning. THIS DOCUMENT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE AN EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT, APPOINTMENT LETTER, SALARY OFFER, OR DIRECT RECRUITMENT ORDER.

(B) NO PLACEMENT GUARANTEE: Indian Alliance Services does NOT guarantee, warrant, or promise employment, jobs, or permanent posting in any airline, airport, or ground handling agency. Successful completion of the course awards a Certificate of Training Completion. Final selection in the aviation sector is the exclusive discretion of hiring employers based on merit, personal interviews, medical fitness, and BCAS security vetting.

(C) NO OFFICIAL AIRLINE AFFILIATION: Indian Alliance Services is not a subsidiary or hiring agent of Jetstar Airways, Air India, IndiGo, or any specific airline. All airline brand marks and codes referenced in training coursework are used solely for educational, pedagogical, and simulation purposes.
8. Confidentiality & Academy Course Materials

All course guides, mock tests, simulation software, presentations, and intellectual materials supplied by the Institute remain the exclusive property of Indian Alliance Services. Trainees shall not record, copy, distribute, or commercially exploit any educational content.

9. Medical Fitness & Safety Guidelines

Aviation training involves active standing, simulation drills, and situational exercises. The Trainee affirms that they possess adequate physical fitness and have disclosed any pre-existing medical conditions that might impair participation.
